roadmap_item.title: Enforce the approved SDD Lite delivery contract
roadmap_item.description: Make plan revisions, criteria, tasks, evidence, and blocked-task recovery trustworthy and revision scoped.
roadmap_item.rationale: Phase 1 is the authority and completion foundation for resumable SDD Lite execution.

goal: An approved Cassor plan revision is the single executable delivery contract, with revision-scoped criteria, required verification, explicit authority, evidence history, and recoverable task blocking.

included: Revision-scoped acceptance criteria with stable keys and carry-forward behavior
Atomic plan, criterion, task, and roadmap recording
Active plan authority and stale-task execution guards
Completion evidence, attributed waivers, and verification history
Blocked-task resume transition and cassor check invariants
Legacy database migration and policy documentation

decisions: The latest approved revision becomes active and older approved revisions remain historical.
Criterion keys are stable within an item and unchanged keys carry forward into an amendment.
Legacy plans retain their historical approval but missing criteria remain unresolved until explicitly verified or waived.
acceptance_criteria: Recording a plan atomically persists its criteria and task verification requirements or persists nothing.
Unresolved applicable criteria and missing required evidence prevent item completion.
Historical approved revisions cannot start tasks after a newer revision becomes active.
A blocked task can resume and complete while retaining its blocking history.
Existing databases migrate deterministically and cassor check reports legacy missing evidence instead of treating it as a pass.
constraints: Retain SQLite and the CLI as the working foundation.
Preserve prior verification records and approval history.
Do not silently convert legacy missing evidence into passing state.

tasks.title: Add revision-scoped delivery contract schema and migration
tasks.description: Add active revision authority, stable criterion identity, task verification requirements, waiver attribution, evidence history, and deterministic legacy backfill.

tasks.title: Enforce atomic recording and lifecycle transitions
tasks.description: Record criteria with plans, validate meaningful criteria and verification, carry unchanged criteria across amendments, gate completion on evidence, and add blocked-task resume.

tasks.title: Extend invariant checks and document legacy policy
tasks.description: Detect stale authority, incomplete contracts, invalid evidence and waiver records, and document the migration and recovery behavior.

risks: Existing databases contain approved plans without structured criteria; migration must preserve history and leave unresolved work visible.
Changing packet criterion shape can affect older adapters; accept legacy strings while emitting structured criteria.
